text:
nina: Heads-up: Q2 entitlement cleanup proposal. I'd like to run a staggered surgical prune next month targeting stale admin bindings and ownerless service accounts. Includes KMS grant reviews. Proposal: 3-day wave per team, ~30 bindings per wave, 48h observation each, auto-rebind if critical signals. Feedback?

dmitri: +1 on staggered. Please export snapshot first and store with hash. Who signs the final list before removals?

oscar: Runbook note: add explicit KMS rollback step (re-grant keyRole -> rebind service account) and verify decrypt ops in logs before/after. Also avoid mass touching keys used by payments.

nina: Plan detail: wave cadence = nightly windows 02:00-04:00 UTC; teams: infra, api-platform, web-app. Dry-run (no changes) published 72h before each window. Auto-rebind triggers: sustained 403 spike on deploys, KMS denied >4/min for 10m, or app error-rate + pager hits. If any trigger -> immediate rebind + open incident channel.

dmitri: Metric thresholds sound reasonable. Suggest baseline: compare to 7d median, trigger if >3x for 10m. Also capture rollout CI failures (job failures/sec).

oscar: Quick KMS log search to watch during waves:

```
resource.type="k8s_cluster" OR resource.type="gce_instance"
protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" OR protoPayload.methodName:"Encrypt"
protoPayload.status.code=7
severity>=ERROR
```

oscar: And simple IAM diff flow I use:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJ --format=json > iam-before-$TS.json
# after run
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJ --format=json > iam-after-$TS.json
# diff with jq script to find removed/added principals
```

nina: Good. Permissions: we'll exclude proj-payments-prod and any project tagged "no-prune". I'll tag team owners in the dry-run post and ask for explicit ACK.

oncall-bot: scheduler: entitlement-prune-wave-1 scheduled for 2026-04-07T02:00Z -> 2026-04-07T04:00Z (proj-infra).

sec-bot: checklist-reminder: please attach pre-export hashes and get @sre-lead + @product-security signoff before any removal.

dmitri: Who will run the removal automation? I can operate the gcloud + terraform shim if someone pushes the pr.

oscar: I can prepare the automation PR and mark it DO-NOT-MERGE until approvals. Will include a one-hour cooldown after any auto-rebind to avoid flip-flop.

nina: Perfect. Dry-run posting tomorrow morning with full principal list and S3 path: gs://redwood-sec-exports/entitlement-snapshots/2026-04-04-TS4441007890.tar.gz sha256:abc123...

dmitri: Please @mention me when posted. I'll review the KMS principals.

oscar: Also adding a short test to the runbook: post-change smoke that attempts a non-critical decrypt against each touched key to validate access is unaffected.

sre-lead: acked. Make sure oncall rotations know which pager to mute for false positives during waves.

product-security: acked. We'll review the dry-run list when posted.

nina: Thanks all. Locking in wave-1 dry-run tomorrow. No removals until we have both acks. DM me if you see gaps. :lock:
